author: Inside Edition
description: Lindsay Clancy spent Labor Day weekend in a Massachusetts state-run psychiatric facility, after her murder trial ended dramatically in a mistrial last week. Now, as talk of a retrial builds, her lawyer, Kevin Reddington, is hoping for a quicker resolution. Reddington reportedly asked President Trump to pardon Clancy. But is the president legally empowered to do that? Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports.
title: Lindsay Clancy's Lawyer Asks President Trump To Pardon Her

author: Inside Edition
description: An Arizona realtor named Arthur Lundeen had a violent outburst on an American Airlines flight from Texas over the weekend. 67-year-old Lundeen was eventually duct-taped to his seat. Now, those heroes who restrained the unruly passenger are speaking out. Richard O'Lenick and Juan Mejia say they were trying to deescalate the situation, before Lundeen started biting them. They spoke with Inside Edition's Justin Finch.
title: Heroes Who Duct-Taped Unruly Plane Passenger Speak Out

author: Inside Edition
description:
Five-year-old Samuel loves to go outside and collect goose feathers near his home in Virginia. But when his mom Karyann Parkinson let him go to a local pond alone, she ended up in big trouble. Parkinson was floored when cops arrested her and put her on a child abuse registry.
She plans on appealing the conviction to try to clear her name. The incident has sparked a debate about parenting and play. Parkinson spoke with Inside Edition.
title: Mom Who Let Son Play Outside Convicted On Neglected Related Charges

author: Inside Edition
description: What a milestone! "The View" is celebrating its 30th season, and the venerable show invited Inside Edition behind the scenes as the ladies returned from summer break. Inside Edition's Alison Hall caught up with Whoopi Goldberg. Co-host Joy Behar made history hosting more seasons of an American talk show than any other woman.
title: Alison Hall Goes Behind The Scenes At 'The View'

author: Inside Edition
description: A traffic stop got physical, as a deputy said he was knocked down while trying to prevent a suspect from fleeing. The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office in Florida says the deputy flagged down the motorcyclist for speeding. While the driver did stop, video shows he took off when the deputy approached and put his hand on the vehicle. Court documents say the deputy was knocked to the ground. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputy Knocked Over By Fleeing Motorcyclist: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a true deer-in-the-headlights moment when one Florida homeowner found an unexpected visitor inside his home -- and in the bathroom, of all places. He called the local sheriff's department. Deputies responded and helped him escort the buck outside. However, the wild animal wanted to play some reindeer games and jumped into the backyard pool -- not once, but twice. Using only their wits and a pool brush, deputies helped the buck safely return to the woods.
title: Florida Man Finds Deer in His Bathroom

author: Inside Edition
description: Maya Auchincloss from Toronto is preparing to amputate her foot after battling cancer and dealing with excruciating pain since childhood.
title: Young Circus Artist Prepares To Lose Her Foot #shorts
